recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片拼圖中多為核偏位、細胞質深藍且有核周淡染區（hof）的漿細胞，其中數顆細胞含兩個大小相近的細胞核（雙核漿細胞），部分核內可見淡色圓形包涵體與小核仁。
features: Numerous plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Several binucleated plasma cells with two similar-sized nuclei in abundant blue cytoplasm
Coarse clock-face to moderately clumped chromatin; small nucleoli visible in some nuclei
Occasional pale round intranuclear/overlying inclusions, compatible with Dutcher bodies, and a cell with multiple clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Plasma cells form clusters with scattered granulocytes and red cells in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (composite) shows increased plasma cells, many in clusters, with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs. Several binucleated plasma cells are present, some with visible nucleoli, and occasional cells contain pale round inclusions overlying the nucleus (compatible with Dutcher bodies) or multiple cytoplasmic vacuoles. Scattered granulocytes are seen in the background. The prominence of clustered, binucleated and nucleolated plasma cells is suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm; quantitation, CD138 immunostaining and light-chain restriction are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually mature, scattered or perivascular, rarely clustered, and polytypic, whereas clustered nucleolated and binucleated plasma cells favor clonality confirmed by kappa/lambda restriction.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with mast cells, and MYD88 L265P, rather than a predominant sheet of plasma cells.
Plasmablasts have larger nuclei with dispersed chromatin, prominent central nucleoli and high N:C ratio, more immature than these mostly mature-appearing plasma cells.
Osteoblasts are larger with eccentric nuclei and a hof placed away from the nucleus and occur in small clusters in pediatric/regenerating marrow, and are not binucleated plasma cells.
